title: signal-lens detection specs (phase 2)
description: Output of step 8. Takes the enumerated signals from phase 1 and states, for each, exactly what must be detected. Nothing is dropped: a signal nobody can currently detect keeps its entry with method 'none_known', because a high-ranked undetectable signal is the argument for building a new tool in phase 3. Written to ./signal-lens/<domain>.signals.json and validated by scripts/validate_signals.py.

profile.description: Path to the seller profile these were derived from. The specs are only as good as it.

signals.description: One entry per row of the phase 1 CSV. The floor matches the CSV's: fewer than twenty means the set was summarised upstream.

library_type.description: Which library type this is an instance of, or 'new'. Makes it visible when a whole type has been dropped between phases.

surface.description: Resolvable locations, not platforms. 'r/Accounting' or 'g2.com/products/{competitor}/reviews', never 'Reddit'. A surface nobody can navigate to is not a surface.

observable.description: The thing you actually read. 'none' only where method is none_known.

method.description: none_known is a legitimate answer and must not be used to hide a signal that was simply not thought about. Pair it with why in `unspecifiable_because`.

query.description: The pattern. Terms come from artifacts.vocabulary.buyer_language and competitor names from artifacts.competitors — not from the seller's own website.

must_also_have.description: The three gates from step 3, made machine-checkable. `count_of` names the noun for the profile cross-check; it is the PATTERNS that count toward evidence_density, because a field being non-empty costs nothing and a working regex does not.

count_of.description: The severity noun from the profile. Its presence is what separates venting from intent.

numeric_pattern.description: A regex the match must also satisfy, enforcing an actual quantity of the severity noun — e.g. '\\d+\\s*(entities|companies)'. Must contain a digit class. This is the COUNT gate made real: venting has adjectives, intent has integers.

date_pattern.description: A regex extracting a date or interval FROM THE TEXT, never the crawl timestamp. Must contain a digit class.

disqualifiers.description: The step 4 doppelgangers, expressed as exclusions. An empty list means nobody stress-tested this signal.

baseline.description: Presence signals need a stored earlier observation. Without one you can read current state but not movement, which is the actual signal.

freshness_days.description: How long the signal stays live after the observable appears. A 60-day grace-period post is strong on day two and dead on day fifty-five.

yields.description: What you end up holding. 'no' is a valid and useful answer - see step 5.

unspecifiable_because.description: Required when method is none_known. A reason about this signal, never 'could not think of a query'.

rank.description: Components, not a verdict. scripts/rank_signals.py computes the score from these, so a rank cannot be asserted without stating what produced it. Every component is a prior until backtested against closed-won data.

stage.description: 0 problem-unaware · 1 problem-aware · 2 solution-aware · 3 vendor-aware · 4 in-negotiation. How close the observable sits to a decision.

evidence_density.description: How many of {numeric_pattern, date_pattern, query.near} the spec actually enforces. Derived from the spec and cross-checked, so it cannot be claimed without the patterns being there.

separability.description: 0 the doppelganger needs a human · 1 partly expressible as rules · 2 fully expressible. Low separability caps precision no matter how good the query is.

reach.description: 0 one entity · 1 a small recurring stream · 2 a cohort stranded at once, where one detection enumerates many.

contestedness.description: How much competition is already fishing this signal. 0 every vendor watches it (renewal threads, review sites) - 1 some do - 2 essentially nobody (public registers, category-unaware posts). Without this the stage weighting buries the only uncontested volume in the market, which is where there is no competition at all.
